paper_title: Searching for vector dark matter with an optomechanical accelerometer
coupling_convention: dimensionless g_B-L (coupling strength relative to electromagnetism, as defined in Eq. 12 of the paper)
notes: Proposal/projection paper (no measurement performed). Projected sensitivity to B-L coupled dark photons for Si3N4-membrane/Be-mirror optomechanical accelerometers (Fig. 2, tau = 1 year curves). No numerical table given; the four data points are resonance-peak sensitivities estimated by evaluating Eq. 12b with the paper's stated parameters (Q0=1e9, T=10 mK, f12=0.05, beta=(4/pi)^2, Q_DM~5e5, a0=3.7e11 m/s^2, 200-nm membranes of size 20/10/5/2.5 cm at ~2/5/10/20-25 kHz), consistent with the figure axes (g_B-L reaching ~1e-24-1e-23, exceeding Eot-Wash g~1e-22 by >1 order of magnitude). Between resonances the sensitivity is much worse; these points represent the on-resonance envelope only. Paper also projects B-coupled dark photon sensitivity (Fig. 4, f12=0.0018), not extracted here. Confidence level not explicitly stated (SNR=1 criterion used); 0.95 is a placeholder.
